title: Country pack index
description: Draft. The decoded payload of the signed per-country index of published and withdrawn pack versions (envelope prefix cpi1., ADR-0071 items 1.5 and 1.6, Proposed). One per key environment and country. CMP-038 issues a new one on every publish, republish, withdrawal, floor raise and follow-up closure; CMP-039 verifies it. Unknown keys are refused. Rules JSON Schema cannot express are in x-validator-rules.
x-validator-rules: each version appears at most once in published, and no version in published appears in withdrawn (index_malformed)
predecessorDigest is the digest of the exact payload bytes of the index with indexSeq minus 1; two different indexes never share an indexSeq
indexSeq never goes down, floor never goes down and no withdrawn entry is ever dropped relative to any index already verified (index_rollback, floor_regression, withdrawal_reversed)
every followUpOpen publishId is a published entry's publishId

every withdrawal, floor raise and follow-up closure since the previous index is listed in changeRecords; each change record carries the same two-person sign-off as a publish (CMP-038 defines its body)
keyEnv equals the signing key's environment and the deployment key environment; a retired key never verifies an index

predecessorDigest.description: Digest of the previous index payload; null only on the first index (indexSeq 1).

floor.description: Lowest version any tenant may be pinned to.

followUpOpen.description: publishIds of urgent versions whose follow-up review is still open.
